1. Setting up the working directory

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/sojic/Documents/TimeSeries")
setwd("C:/Users/sojic/Documents/TimeSeries")
getwd()
```

2. Loading the libraries:

```{r}
library("fuzzySim")
library("ggplot2")
library(ggsignif)
library(MCMC.qpcr)
```

3. Loading the Ct data:

```{r}
data <- read.csv("wnt_Ct_data.csv")
efficiency <- read.csv("Efficiency2.csv")
```

---

Running `MCMC.qpcr` in the ***naive mode***

1. Transforming the PCR data into count data

```{r}
data_count <- cq2counts(
  data = data,
  effic = efficiency,
  genecols = c(3:12),
  condcols = c(1:2)
)
```

Specifying "Norm" as the global control:

```{r}
data_count$Time.Point <- relevel(data_count$Time.Point, ref = "Norm")
```


2. Fitting "naive" model:

```{r}
naive_model <- mcmc.qpcr(
  data = data_count,
  fixed = "Time.Point",
  random = "sample"
)
```

3. Plotting the data:

```{r}
naive_model_plots <- HPDsummary(model=naive_model, 
                                data=data_count, 
                                relative = TRUE, 
                                x.order = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5", "Day 7", "Day 14", "Day 21"))
```
 Extracting the data (the upper triangle are log2 fold differences, the lower triangle are the p-values). NOTE: the p-values need to be adjusted for multiple comparisons:
 
```{r}
#naive_model_data_myc <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt6
naive_model_data_wnt6 <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt6
naive_model_data_wnt3 <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt3
naive_model_data_wnt9 <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt9
naive_model_data_wnt4 <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt4
naive_model_data_wnt5 <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt5
naive_model_data_wnt10 <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt10
naive_model_data_wnt16 <- naive_model_plots$geneWise$wnt16
```

---

Running `MCMC.qpcr` in the ***informed mode***

1. Using the same count-transformed data set `data_count` as above for the naive mode

2. Fitting the model

```{r}
informed_model <- mcmc.qpcr(
  data = data_count,
  fixed = "Time.Point",
  random = "sample",
  controls = c("tuba", "tubb", "ubc"),
  m.fix = 1.2,
  normalize = TRUE
)
```

3. Plotting:

```{r}
informed_model_plots <- HPDsummary(model=informed_model, 
                                data=data_count, 
                                relative = TRUE, 
                                x.order = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5", "Day 7", "Day 14", "Day 21"))
```

Extracting the data:

```{r}
informed_model_data_wnt6 <- informed_model_plots$geneWise$wnt6
informed_model_data_wnt3 <- informed_model_plots$geneWise$wnt3
informed_model_data_wnt9 <- informed_model_plots$geneWise$wnt9
informed_model_data_wnt4 <- informed_model_plots$geneWise$wnt4
informed_model_data_wnt5 <- informed_model_plots$geneWise$wnt5b
informed_model_data_wnt10 <- informed_model_plots$geneWise$wnt10
informed_model_data_wnt16 <- informed_model_plots$geneWise$wnt16
```

---

Running `MCMC.qpcr` in the ***"classic" mode***. The requirements are satisfied: (a) the majority of the Cq values are < 30 and none of them are higher than 32)

1. Generating a log-transformed efficiency-corrected dataset:

```{r}
data_log_transformed <- cq2log(
  data = data,
  genecols = c(3:12),
  condcols = c(1:2),
  effic=efficiency
)
```

2. Specifying "Norm" as the global control:

```{r}
data_log_transformed$Time.Point <- relevel(data_log_transformed$Time.Point, ref = "Norm") 
```

3. Fitting the "classic" model 

```{r}
classic_model <- mcmc.qpcr.classic(
  data = data_log_transformed,
  fixed = "Time.Point",
  #random = "sample",
  controls = c("tuba", "tubb", "ubc")
)
```

3. Plotting:

```{r}
classic_model_plots <- HPDsummary(model=classic_model, 
                                data=data_log_transformed, 
                                relative = TRUE, 
                                x.order = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5", "Day 7", "Day 14", "Day 21"),
                                genes = c("wnt9","wnt6", "wnt3a", "wnt4", "wnt5b","wnt10b","wnt16")
                                )
```
```{r}
#classic_model_plots$ggPlot + annotate("text", x = "Day 14", y = 1.2, label = "*", size = 5)
```
Extracting the data:

```{r}
classic_model_data_wnt6 <- classic_model_plots$geneWise$wnt6
classic_model_data_wnt3 <- classic_model_plots$geneWise$wnt3a
classic_model_data_wnt9 <- classic_model_plots$geneWise$wnt9
classic_model_data_wnt4 <- classic_model_plots$geneWise$wnt4
classic_model_data_wnt5 <- classic_model_plots$geneWise$wnt5b
classic_model_data_wnt10 <- classic_model_plots$geneWise$wnt10b
classic_model_data_wnt16 <- classic_model_plots$geneWise$wnt16
```

```{r}
classic_model_data_wnt4
```

```{r}
pvalues <- data.frame(var = c("Day 1","Day 3","Day 5","Day 7","Day 14","Day 21"), pval = c(0.23899535,0.029539668,0.056735071,0.262746598,0.002893704,0.195078582))
padjusted <- FDR(pvalues = pvalues)
padjustedkeep <- padjusted$select
FDR(pvalues = pvalues)
```
